readme.summary: Excellent getting-started experience with clear purpose, installation, and a working code example, but lacks in-depth configuration docs, multiple use-case examples, and troubleshooting guidance within the README itself.
readme.top_issue: No configuration reference or troubleshooting section — users must leave the README and dig through external docs to understand available Graph options or resolve common problems.

common_complaints: Cell removal method (removeCells) causing duplicate nodes
Layout functionality broken (dagreLayout.layout not a function)
Custom tools not hidden on node collapse (v2.x regression from v1.x)
sentiment.summary: Project shows significant maintenance issues with multiple critical regressions in recent versions, zero response to the newest issue (7+ days), years-old unresolved feature requests, and consistent 'waiting for maintainer' labels across all recent issues.

concerns: Zero commits in past 6 months - no active development
Zero closed issues in past 6 months - issues not being triaged
No merged pull requests in 6 months - not accepting changes
No active contributors in past 6 months - maintainers disengaged
Unknown release information - cannot assess version currency
positive_signals: Recent commit on 2026-02-25 indicates repository still has some activity
maintenance.summary: Package is stale with zero maintenance activity over the past 6 months and 127 unresolved issues accumulating without triage or engagement.

changelog.summary: Changelog is well-structured, clearly marks breaking changes and provides detailed migration guides.

governance.summary: The governance documentation for @antv/x6 outlines a clear decision-making process and path from contributor to maintainer, indicating multiple maintainers with merge rights. However, there is no explicit succession plan in place.
